# 3NewsNow

> > KMTV 3 News Now is an Omaha-based news station providing local news coverage, consumer advice, and viewer support services.

3NewsNow.com serves the Omaha, Nebraska market with breaking news, weather updates, and investigative reporting. The site includes a dedicated support portal for technical assistance and viewer inquiries.

## Key Topics

- KMTV Omaha
- Local news coverage
- Consumer protection
- Tax advice
- Stimulus checks
- Support portal
- Viewer assistance
- Nebraska news
- Weather updates
- Investigative reporting
- Community news
- Breaking news
- Helpdesk support
- Technical assistance

## Support & Help

- [Support : KMTV Omaha Support Portal](https://support.3newsnow.com): KMTV Omaha support portal homepage with FAQs and ticket submission
- [HelpDesk: How Do I Submit A New Support Ticket? : KMTV Omaha Support Portal](https://support.3newsnow.com/support/solutions/articles/5000535023-helpdesk-how-do-i-submit-a-new-support-ticket-): Guide for submitting support tickets to KMTV Omaha helpdesk

## Consumer News & Money

- [Don't worry, stimulus checks won't affect your tax return](https://3newsnow.com/money/consumer/dont-waste-your-money/dont-worry-stimulus-checks-wont-affect-your-tax-return): Consumer advice on stimulus checks and IRS tax return implications
